issue.title: Validate headroom usage for PFC Traffic

failure.body:
**Description**
Validating PFC headroom usage for varying response times to PFC Pause Frames from different DUTs. Test Case can be found here https://github.com/developfast/sonic-mgmt/blob/dojha/headroom-doc/docs/testplan/pfc/PFC_PAUSE_RESPONSE_HEADROOM_README.md

resolution.title: Headroom Check Test Case - PFC Test Gap
resolution.description:
Fix #7082 ### Description of PR Summary:

This PR is to introduce two new test cases to test headroom capacities for pfc enabled traffic. For now, all the new test cases are conditioned for Cisco 8102 and Arista 7050CX3.

No. | Test case | What to verify -- | -- | -- 1 | test_pfc_single_lossless_headroom | The test case is to test headroom capacity for DUT for a single lossless priority. 2 | test_pfc_pause_multi_lossless_headroom | The test case is to test headroom capacity for DUT for multiple lossless priorities. Fixes #7082 Both tests check for cases when headroom should not be exceeded, and when it should, and thus fail. ### Type of change - [ ] Bug fix - [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement) - [x] Test case(new/improvement) ### Back port request - [ ] 201911 - [x] 202012 - [x] 202205 ### Approach #### What is the motivation for this PR? This was from a testgap - #7082. #### How did you do it? Modified the pfc pause quanta from all packets sent by the ixia traffic generator to simulate a delay in response, and see if the headroom capacity is exceeded. #### How did you verify/test it? Need to check, waiting to restore the traffic generator API #### Any platform specific information? #### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case? ### Documentation
